description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 识别文字时，智能排版会把跨行文字合并成自然段落。复制选中的文字时会保留选区内的换行。
- 翻译图片时，智能合并能更好地保留原图的段落、列表和多列排版。
- Windows 用户可在设置中切换性能、正常和节能模式，按需调整应用的耗电和运行速度。
- 修复录屏选区的边框偏移，以及调整阴影宽度时光标方向不正确的问题。

## English

- Smart typesetting joins wrapped lines of recognized text into paragraphs. Copying selected text preserves the line breaks in your selection.
- Smart Merge better preserves paragraphs, lists, and columns when translating images.
- On Windows, choose Performance, Normal, or Power saving in Settings to balance speed and battery use.
- Fixed misaligned recording borders and the resize cursor pointing the wrong way when adjusting shadow width.

## 下载指南 / Download guide

完整版包含全部功能。Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动文字识别。也可在 [Gitee 发布页](https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/tag/v1.6.0_snow-shot) 下载同名文件。

Snow Shot includes all features. Mini is smaller and includes screenshots, annotations, pinned images, collages, recording, and manual text recognition. The same downloads are available on [Gitee](https://gitee.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/tag/v1.6.0_snow-shot).

## macOS 快速安装 / Quick install

